widgets_values:
The negative is kept, not wired

The CLIP Text Encode carries a short negative (ANATOMY, IMAGE, SCENE).

The model runs at CFG 1: the sampler reads the positive only, a negative
has nothing to push against. So the Sampler's negative pin is left open
on purpose -- unwired it is the zeroed positive -- and the CLIP Text
Encode does not encode the negative text at all (no extra pass).

To use the negative: raise cfg above 1 and wire the CLIP Text Encode's
negative to the Sampler's negative.

nodes.title: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS
widgets_values:
H3 IMAGE FOX -- no LoRAs (Polyhedron Suite v407)

MiniMax H3 Image int8, 3200 x 2560 (8 MP), seed 2094697662 fixed.

Blank picture MID GREY 0-0.25 (Image Reference): the prompt is encoded together with an empty grey picture for the first part of the run, then as text only. The window is read on the model's own sigma grid (sigma >= 0.9275): the first 2 of its 6 native steps, but steps 1-4 of 8 on the curve used here. The Sampler prints the real steps in the console. The effect depends on the motif -- switch blank_picture off for an A/B.

Sampling: euler on an 8-step curve (1, .931506, .839236, .703462, .5, .296538, .160764, .068494, 0) shifted 12, cfg 1. No LoRA, no accelerator -- the look comes from the curve.

Refine: Power Upscale with its own curve 1, 0.08, 0 on sigmas, denoise 0.16 -> 2 steps.
Upscale: Power Upscale, refine OFF -- no model pass: ESRGAN 4x Universal Neutral, then lanczos 0.65 = 2080 x 1664.
Clarity: Filter, sharpen masked to edges 0.35 (masking 0.7).

Models: minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot, text encoder qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq, image VAE minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16, upscaler 4x_UniversalUpscalerV2-Neutral_115000_swaG. The loaders find them in any sub folder.
